sources.snippet: Method StreamTalk uses a generate-retrieve-refine cycle to periodically pull streaming motion back toward a plausible pose distribution. Architecture. During training, Stochastic Anchor Masking (SAM) randomly hides pose and translation frames so the model learns to reconstruct full motion from sparse boundary cues.

sources.snippet: Real-time co-speech gesture generation must produce 3D motion clip by clip as speech arrives. Existing streaming methods are open-loop: each clip depends on past context, but the model cannot check or correct its trajectory. sources.title: StreamTalk: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Key-Pose Anchoring
sources.snippet: We instantiate this paradigm in StreamTalk: SPG closes the loop through a generate-retrieve-refine cycle at each clip boundary, while SAM trains the model to inpaint motion from sparse anchors so that it can fully exploit the retrieved key poses. A single destination anchor per clip is sufficient for effective correction.
